after.problem:
Which of the following represents the solution to the system of linear equations given below?

$$
{\begin{aligned}6x-4y=2 \\ -x+y=-1\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
This system can be written as

$$
[\begin{aligned}6 & -4 \\ -1 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1\end{aligned}].
$$

To find the solution, we need to calculate the inverse of the coefficient matrix 
$A=[\begin{aligned}6 & -4 \\ -1 & 1\end{aligned}].$
This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1} & =\frac{1}{6\cdot 1-(-4)\cdot (-1)}[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 1 & 6\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{2}[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 1 & 6\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

We can now represent the solution to this system, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =\frac{1}{2}[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 1 & 6\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

content.knowledge_point: Solving a 2x2 System of Equations Using an Inverse Matrix
content.problem:
Which of the following represents the solution to the system of linear equations given below?

$$
{\begin{aligned}6x-4y=2 \\ -x+y=-1\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
This system can be written as

$$
[\begin{aligned}6 & -4 \\ -1 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1\end{aligned}].
$$

To find the solution, we need to calculate the inverse of the coefficient matrix 
$A=[\begin{aligned}6 & -4 \\ -1 & 1\end{aligned}].$
This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1} & =\frac{1}{6\cdot 1-(-4)\cdot (-1)}[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 1 & 6\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{2}[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 1 & 6\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

We can now represent the solution to this system, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =\frac{1}{2}[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 1 & 6\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

after.name: Question 2
after.problem:
Which of the following represents the solution to the system of linear equations given below?

$$
{\begin{aligned}2x+6y=46 \\ 8x+y=-23\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
This system can be written as

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & 6 \\ 8 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}46 \\ -23\end{aligned}].
$$

To find the solution, we need to calculate the inverse of the coefficient matrix 
$A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 6 \\ 8 & 1\end{aligned}].$
This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1} & =\frac{1}{2\cdot 1-6\cdot 8}[\begin{aligned}1 & -6 \\ -8 & 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =-\frac{1}{46}[\begin{aligned}1 & -6 \\ -8 & 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

We can now represent the solution to this system, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =-\frac{1}{46}[\begin{aligned}1 & -6 \\ -8 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}46 \\ -23\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

content.problem:
Which of the following represents the solution to the system of linear equations given below?

$$
{\begin{aligned}2x+6y=46 \\ 8x+y=-23\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
This system can be written as

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & 6 \\ 8 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}46 \\ -23\end{aligned}].
$$

To find the solution, we need to calculate the inverse of the coefficient matrix 
$A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 6 \\ 8 & 1\end{aligned}].$
This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1} & =\frac{1}{2\cdot 1-6\cdot 8}[\begin{aligned}1 & -6 \\ -8 & 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =-\frac{1}{46}[\begin{aligned}1 & -6 \\ -8 & 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

We can now represent the solution to this system, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =-\frac{1}{46}[\begin{aligned}1 & -6 \\ -8 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}46 \\ -23\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

after.name: Question 3
after.problem:
Which of the following represents the solution to the system of linear equations given below?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}4x-2y=4 \\ 6=5x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we reorganize the equations so that they are in the right order, to get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}4x-2y=4 \\ 5x=6.\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can represent this system of equations in the form $Ax=b:$

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & -2 \\ 5 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 6\end{aligned}].
$$

To find the solution, we need to calculate the inverse of the coefficient matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}4 & -2 \\ 5 & 0\end{aligned}].$ This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1} & =\frac{1}{4\cdot 0-5\cdot (-2)}[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ -5 & 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{10}[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ -5 & 4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

We can now find the solution to this system as:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =\frac{1}{10}[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ -5 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}4 \\ 6\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}

content.problem:
Which of the following represents the solution to the system of linear equations given below?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}4x-2y=4 \\ 6=5x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we reorganize the equations so that they are in the right order, to get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}4x-2y=4 \\ 5x=6.\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can represent this system of equations in the form $Ax=b:$

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & -2 \\ 5 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 6\end{aligned}].
$$

To find the solution, we need to calculate the inverse of the coefficient matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}4 & -2 \\ 5 & 0\end{aligned}].$ This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1} & =\frac{1}{4\cdot 0-5\cdot (-2)}[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ -5 & 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{10}[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ -5 & 4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

We can now find the solution to this system as:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =\frac{1}{10}[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ -5 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}4 \\ 6\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
